posts.title: 15 Senate Democrats Help Republicans Pass ‘Giant Giveaway to Big Tech and Polluters’
posts.description: “It’s bad enough that Republicans wanted to gut our environmental laws. It’s unconscionable that Democrats helped them do it.” By Jake Johnson Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer (D-NY) and Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse (D-RI) speak at a press conference on September 24, 2026 in Washington, DC. (Photo by Tasos Katopodis/Getty Images) The Republican-controlled US Senate , with the support of more than a dozen Democrats, passed a hotly contested bill that would weaken the Clean Water Act , the Endangered Species Act , and other key environmental laws to accelerate approval and development of energy projects, including climate-wrecking gas pipelines and data centers . The final vote on the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act (BAAJA) was 62-33 , with nearly every Republican and 15 Democrats supporting passage. posts.title: The Constitution Cannot Defend Democracy by Itself – That is the Work of Peace
posts.description: By George Cassidy Payne Hamilton believed American institutions could restrain political ambition. Today, the survival of democratic government depends on something the Constitution cannot guarantee: the courage to resist abuses of power without abandoning the principles of peace . When Alexander Hamilton defended the proposed Constitution in 1788, he worried about the dangers of political ambition and leaders who might exploit public passions for personal advancement. In Federalist No. 68, he defended the Electoral College as a safeguard against the election of an unqualified or manipulative president. He envisioned a process in which electors would exercise independent judgment, choosing someone distinguished by “ability and virtue” rather than political celebrity or the “little arts of popularity.” More than two centuries later, the American presidency has exposed the limitations of that vision. posts.title: The fight for democracy isn’t over
posts.description: By Bob Topper The election was a major setback for Trump and the MAGA party. But still, our Republic is in danger. The Project 2025 Christian Nationalist crowd continue to run the administration. And with the appointment of the fanatical Stephen Miller as chief of staff, Trump appears to be doubling down. Moreover, with his suspected cognitive decline, he may pose an even greater threat to the social order that our nation and Western allies have enjoyed for generations. Other powers seek to destroy our Republic. Trump’s best friend Vladimir Putin despises America for its principles and its support of Ukraine’s fight for independence and democracy. And internally, players like Elon Musk and Peter Thiel scorn democratic governance, which they view as inefficient and obsolete. They supported Trump’s autocratic ambitions.
